                  id="Definitions_ComplianceAudit"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/compliance-audit">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditReadiness" name="Audit readiness"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditFindings" name="Audit findings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Corrections" name="Corrections completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CertificationDocuments" name="Certification documents"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComplianceAudit">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Auditors" name="External auditors" processRef="Process_Auditors"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AuditReadiness" name="Audit readiness" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssess" targetRef="Start_AuditorReview">
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_AuditReadiness</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:messageFlow>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Findings" name="Audit findings" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyGaps" targetRef="Catch_Findings">
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_AuditFindings</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:messageFlow>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Corrections" name="Corrections completed" sourceRef="Task_CorrectIssues" targetRef="Catch_Corrections">
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_Corrections</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:messageFlow>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CertificationDocuments" name="Certification documents" sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="Catch_CertificationDocuments">
      <bpmn:messageRef>Message_CertificationDocuments</bpmn:messageRef>
    </bpmn:messageFlow>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company compliance audit process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Company" name="Compliance audit planned"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScheduleAudit" name="Schedule compliance audit"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelfAssess" name="Conduct self-assessment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Findings" name="Receive audit findings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Findings" messageRef="Message_AuditFindings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CorrectIssues" name="Make necessary corrections or improvements"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CertificationDocuments" name="Receive official certification documents">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CertificationDocuments" messageRef="Message_CertificationDocuments"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Company" name="Process concludes with official documents"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Company" targetRef="Task_ScheduleAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_ScheduleAudit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Task_SelfAssess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssess" targetRef="Catch_Findings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Catch_Findings" targetRef="Task_CorrectIssues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_CorrectIssues" targetRef="Catch_CertificationDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Catch_CertificationDocuments" targetRef="End_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Auditors" name="External audit process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AuditorReview" name="Company ready for external audit">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AuditReadiness" messageRef="Message_AuditReadiness"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProcesses" name="Review company processes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyGaps" name="Identify gaps or issues"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Corrections" name="Receive corrections or improvements">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Corrections" messageRef="Message_Corrections"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalAudit" name="Conduct final audit"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification when all criteria are met"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueDocuments" name="Issue official documents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Auditors" name="Audit process concludes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_AuditorReview" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProcesses" targetRef="Task_IdentifyGaps"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyGaps" targetRef="Catch_Corrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Catch_Corrections" targetRef="Task_FinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_FinalAudit" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="End_Auditors"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: For a message event, put messageRef on its bpmn:messageEventDefinition, never on the event element itself.
rules.situation: the description calls for a message event with an associated message

rules.instruction: When the description states that work is performed after a preparation or readiness stage: Model the performed work as a distinct activity/task in the sequence; do not represent readiness for that work as an event in its place.
rules.situation: the description states that work is performed after a preparation or readiness stage

rules.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules.situation: the description states a distinct occurrence that starts the process or an outcome that marks it complete

rules.instruction: When the description states that several activities are all required before a later activity or outcome: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize all branches with a parallel gateway before the later activity or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states that several activities must all be completed before a later activity and does not specify their order

rules.instruction: When the description states that a reviewer examines a process or other work and identifies findings: Model the examination as a distinct activity; do not represent only the findings or omit the examination.
rules.situation: the description states that a reviewer examines a process or other work and identifies findings

rules.instruction: When the description states that a distinct activity occurs between a preceding process stage and a later activity: Model the activity as a separate task and connect it to the preceding and following flow in the stated order.
rules.situation: the description states that a distinct activity occurs between a preceding process stage and a later activity

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states the outcome that marks the process as complete: label the end event with a concise phrase that faithfully names that outcome, rather than a generic label or an unnecessarily detailed restatement
rules.situation: the description explicitly states the outcome that completes the process
